resources.string:
The backup is restored. Its settings take effect after the app restarts: until then the app keeps the old ones in memory, and changing a setting, or the connection saving its state, would write them back over the restore.

Restart now stops the connection (in Root Mode the daemon too) and reopens the app; start the connection again from the main screen.

Later leaves the restored files in place: stop the connection and force-stop the app yourself before you change anything.
